```{r analysis_setup, include=FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("MASS", quietly = TRUE) ||
    !requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("This report requires the MASS and knitr R packages.")
}

seed <- 43207
set.seed(seed)
possible_data_paths <- c(
  file.path("..", "homework", "week-07", "data", "saheart.csv"),
  file.path("homework", "week-07", "data", "saheart.csv")
)
data_path <- possible_data_paths[file.exists(possible_data_paths)][1]
if (is.na(data_path)) stop("Could not locate homework/week-07/data/saheart.csv")

heart <- read.csv(data_path)
heart$famhist <- ifelse(heart$famhist == "Absent", 1, 2)
y <- factor(heart$chd, levels = c(0, 1))
X <- as.matrix(heart[, names(heart) != "chd"])
if (anyNA(X) || anyNA(y) || !is.numeric(X)) {
  stop("Predictors and response must be complete, with numeric predictors.")
}

test_idx <- unlist(lapply(levels(y), function(class_label) {
  class_idx <- which(y == class_label)
  sample(class_idx, size = round(0.2 * length(class_idx)))
}), use.names = FALSE)
train_idx <- setdiff(seq_along(y), test_idx)
X_train <- X[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
y_train <- droplevels(y[train_idx])

folds <- 5L
fold_id <- integer(length(train_idx))
for (class_label in levels(y_train)) {
  class_rows <- which(y_train == class_label)
  fold_id[class_rows] <- sample(rep(seq_len(folds), length.out = length(class_rows)))
}

cv_fold_error <- matrix(
  NA_real_, nrow = folds, ncol = 2,
  dimnames = list(NULL, c("LDA", "QDA"))
)
for (fold in seq_len(folds)) {
  analysis_rows <- which(fold_id != fold)
  validation_rows <- which(fold_id == fold)

  lda_fit <- MASS::lda(
    x = X_train[analysis_rows, , drop = FALSE],
    grouping = y_train[analysis_rows]
  )
  qda_fit <- MASS::qda(
    x = X_train[analysis_rows, , drop = FALSE],
    grouping = y_train[analysis_rows]
  )
  lda_pred <- predict(lda_fit, newdata = X_train[validation_rows, , drop = FALSE])$class
  qda_pred <- predict(qda_fit, newdata = X_train[validation_rows, , drop = FALSE])$class
  cv_fold_error[fold, "LDA"] <- mean(lda_pred != y_train[validation_rows])
  cv_fold_error[fold, "QDA"] <- mean(qda_pred != y_train[validation_rows])
}

cv_error <- colMeans(cv_fold_error)
selected_name <- names(which.min(cv_error))
cv_table <- data.frame(
  Candidate = names(cv_error),
  Mean_CV_error = unname(cv_error),
  Selection = ifelse(names(cv_error) == selected_name, "Selected", "")
)

plot_cv_errors <- function() {
  plot(seq_along(cv_error), unname(cv_error),
       type = "n", xaxt = "n", xlim = c(0.7, 2.3),
       ylim = c(0, max(cv_error) * 1.25),
       xlab = "Candidate classifier", ylab = "5-fold CV misclassification rate",
       main = "Training-split cross-validation error")
  axis(1, at = seq_along(cv_error), labels = names(cv_error))
  points(seq_along(cv_error), unname(cv_error),
         pch = c(16, 17), col = c("#176B5B", "#B34A2E"), cex = 1.5)
}

if (selected_name == "LDA") {
  final_fit <- MASS::lda(x = X_train, grouping = y_train)
} else {
  final_fit <- MASS::qda(x = X_train, grouping = y_train)
}
test_pred <- predict(final_fit, newdata = X[test_idx, , drop = FALSE])$class
test_truth <- y[test_idx]
test_confusion <- table(
  Observed = factor(test_truth, levels = levels(y)),
  Predicted = factor(test_pred, levels = levels(y))
)
test_error <- mean(test_pred != test_truth)
```

## Data and procedure

SAheart contains `r nrow(heart)` observations and `r ncol(X)` numerical predictors; `famhist` is coded Absent = 1 and Present = 2. The random seed was <code>43207</code>. A stratified 20% holdout reserved `r length(test_idx)` observations for one final evaluation and left `r length(train_idx)` for training. Ordinary LDA (one pooled covariance) and QDA (one covariance per class), both with empirical class priors, were compared using the same stratified 5-fold partitions within the training split. Selection used mean fold misclassification rate only.

## Cross-validation and selection

```{r cv_table}
knitr::kable(cv_table, digits = 4, align = c("l", "r", "l"),
            col.names = c("Candidate", "Mean 5-fold CV error", "Selection"))
```

```{r save_cv_figure, include=FALSE}
png("saheart-cv-errors.png", width = 1200, height = 650, res = 150)
plot_cv_errors()
dev.off()
```

```{r cv_figure, fig.width=6.2, fig.height=2.4, fig.align="center"}
plot_cv_errors()
```

The lowest-CV-error candidate was **`r selected_name`** (CV error `r sprintf("%.4f", min(cv_error))`). It was refit using all `r length(train_idx)` training observations, then evaluated once on the untouched test split. The held-out test misclassification rate was **`r sprintf("%.4f", test_error)`**.

## Held-out test results

Rows are observed classes; columns are predicted classes.

```{r test_confusion}
knitr::kable(as.data.frame.matrix(test_confusion),
            col.names = c("Predicted 0", "Predicted 1"),
            caption = "Test confusion matrix")
```

The selected model is preferred by cross-validation, not by its test result. The single test estimate has sampling uncertainty. LDA and QDA assume class-conditional normal predictors; binary `famhist` does not follow a normal distribution, so this modeling assumption is a limitation.
